evidence:
Method: manual application of check-probe-not-in-seed.py (the private checker was not run). A script collected every quoted literal, money literal and date literal from all tests/**/*.md and judge.toml files and compared them with the seed (numbers as cents, strings) and with the reference's public HTML/JS/CSS and server source.

1. No named sentinel exists. The only quoted literals in the judge files are criterion ids, config tokens, the documented demo password and the seven account e-mails. No OFF-/REQ-/EMP- identifier appears in any judge file. Identity of judge-created records is carried by judge-chosen unique names: functional/prompt.md:17 'Use unique identifiers with a short per-session suffix'; gates/constraints/prompt.md 'Use unique titles/candidates with a session suffix'; the three scored prompts 'Use a dimension-specific ID suffix'. The workbook's deterministic row says the checker is 'Skipped when no sentinels are named'.

2. Distinctive probe inputs and expected results are absent from the seed and the reference markup: start instants 2024-02-29T12:34:56.789Z, 2024-01-31T12:00:00Z, 2026-07-01, 2026-09-15, 2026-02-01T00:00:00.001Z; relocation 90071992547409.91 and fair/strike 70368744177664.01; P4 terms and results (10000.01, 123.45, 100001.77, 105001.78, 4800.02/7200.03); P6 39.75/60.25; B1 98.23/94.47/90.22, -1.98/+2.04; R1 example 1.23. None occurs in seed_data.json or solution/app/public. Seed-number collisions are limited to rule constants the judge does not create as proof (band floors 200000.00/350000.00, referral bonus 10000.00, vesting 12/24/32) and trivial cents (.01-.06, 10, 20, 40).

3. Seeded names the criteria mention are supplied facts used as inputs, not proofs: the seven accounts and referrers Dara Whitfield/Sofia Marchetti/Omar Haddad (judge.toml:474, 483). The seed holds no accrual for Dara (seed_referral_accruals are EMP-R2 and EMP-R3 only; OFF-101 referred by EMP-R1 is PENDING), so 'exactly one 10000.00 accrual to employee Dara Whitfield' on the judge's own offer is not already present.

4. Near-collisions examined and judged not pre-satisfying:
(a) hro_referral_clock (judge.toml:609) expects 10000.00 vested for referral start 2026-02-01T00:00:00Z and 5000.00 for the .001Z neighbour. The golden imports seeded accrual RA-OFF-111 (Leo Park, EMP-R3, referred_hire_start 2026-02-01T00:00:00Z; db.js:169-174), which by the same rule shows 10000.00 vested, and RA-OFF-110 (2026-02-10) which shows 5000.00. Those rows belong to seeded candidates and offer ids; P8 requires approved judge-created offers with 'different candidates' and offer start 2026-07-01, and the .001Z and 2026-01-31T12:00:00Z cases have no seed counterpart. An app that cannot compute the cliff cannot show the judge's own rows.
(b) The gate's 'valid offer start date such as 2026-09-01' and hro_referral_immediate's offer start 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z equal the reference form's default value (hireops.js:220-221) and several seeded start dates. The date is an ordinary input, not the proof; proof is the uniquely named new record read back in a fresh context, and the distinctive referral start 2026-09-15 is absent everywhere.
(c) P6 requisition budget 100000.00 equals seeded REQ-ENG-3's budget; P6 says 'Independent requisition' and 'No dependence on any seeded requisition's remaining room', and its proofs are movements on the new requisition.
(d) hro_entries_reload: the reference pre-fills a random operation key (change-sets.js:18,44 'chg-'+3 random bytes) but the criterion requires the judge to enter its own distinctive key and terms; the unsent-entry store is per-browser localStorage (change-sets.js:68-77), empty in a fresh judge browser.
(e) hro_audit_readback says 'a static seeded line is insufficient'; hro_restart says 'No seeded-only substitute for successful fresh write'; hro_draft_eligibility is an intended refusal on a seeded DRAFT with a fresh approval as positive control, not a created value.

Broken-app trial: a static seed copy showing all imported rows has no row carrying the judge's suffixed candidate/requisition names or the distinctive instants, so no mutation proof is met by seed content. Conforming-alternative trial: an app that omits the optional demonstration rows (instruction.md:17) loses nothing, since no criterion needs a seeded operational record.

Limits: this is a source review. No configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index.json scope says full configured grading is absent), so whether the configured judge actually applies unique suffixes is unobserved. The 106 KB functional judge.toml was covered by a literal scan plus targeted reading, not read line by line.
